name: mwwpf-file-upload
description: File Upload for MW WP Form

scripts.env:start: bin/mwf-fixture.sh 5.1.8 && wp-env start && npm run env:activate
scripts.env:sim52: bin/mwf-fixture.sh sim52 && wp-env start --update && npm run env:activate
scripts.env:activate: wp-env run cli wp plugin activate mw-wp-form && wp-env run tests-cli wp plugin activate mw-wp-form
scripts.test:php: wp-env run tests-cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/mwwpf-file-upload env WORDPRESS_TABLE_PREFIX=wptests_ vendor/bin/phpunit
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:php && npm run test:e2e
